novelty_gate.unexpected_issue: New concrete failure or external-state change with dated evidence and an affected task.
novelty_gate.new_promising_mechanism: Previously unknown fact, upstream decision/work chain, likely material explanatory reach and next cheap discriminator; not merely a favorable total.
novelty_gate.known_omission: Known unfinished work is a planning omission, case (2), not a discovery.
novelty_gate.approval: No extra task, frozen-scope/budget change or TODO increase without subsequent explicit approval.

tasks.question: Faithful launch setup: source trace, benchmark-local repair, failure-path tests and actual verification; include tracker-rule qualification.
tasks.scope: **Qualify the experiment setup end to end.** Trace the missing 775-byte developer catalog to its loader decision; implement any permitted benchmark-local repair; check actual input, monitor publication, exact cancellation, retries and stale state. Include the approved tracker/completion-rule implementation and fail-first regressions here, not as later tasks.
tasks.completion_gate: A faithful actual launch plus passing relevant failure-path checks. Preserve task/base/model/effort/tools and saved reference; no global config or reference edit. Source access, unsupported repair or failed actual input leaves P01 blocked and dependent experiments unrun.

tasks.question: Exact effective-factor/reference manifest and common-boundary qualification for individual and joint tests.
tasks.scope: **Freeze the complete comparison and joint-test map.** Reuse R01/R07/R12 and the existing source map; enumerate actual effective differences, exposure, immutable reference and non-targets for each proposed contrast. Check whether refresh/wait and author-policy interventions can genuinely coexist in one existing boundary. This includes local qualification of the known joint seams.
tasks.completion_gate: A factor-to-source-to-historical-event manifest, including every retained uncertainty, and a specific common-reference/activation decision for P03–P08. A missing joint implementation boundary is a blocker for its test, not permission to construct an unrestricted new host or compare incompatible cohorts.

tasks.question: Qualified B-only next-action/handoff-guidance screen.
tasks.scope: **Test B alone with qualified input.** One fresh initial-author episode removes the complete result-bound next-action/handoff guidance while keeping A, custody, real accepted commits/check results, repair permission and task obligations.
tasks.completion_gate: Verified B exposure, complete or honestly censored usage, and actual decisions/work compared with the fixed saved all-on author. Setup failure is not a B null. This supplies the clean comparison that R03/R14 did not deliver.

tasks.question: Qualified A+B publication/test-order plus guidance joint screen.
tasks.scope: **Test A+B together with qualified input.** One fresh initial-author episode restores executed test-first/separate publication and removes B, preserving custody and other inputs.
tasks.completion_gate: Actual test-first/publication and subsequent work trace, qualified comparison with the saved all-on author and P03. Attribute A only conditionally on B-off; do not call this an independent A percentage. R04's catalog-confounded observation remains separate.

tasks.question: Exact instruction/feedback → decision → actual work → usage mechanism, before and after first GREEN.
tasks.scope: **Identify the decision mechanism, not just the token difference.** Use the saved and new B/A+B traces to separate through-first-GREEN work from subsequent validation, genuine repair, retries, inspection and handoff. Link the changed clauses and actual feedback to decisions and later charged context.
tasks.completion_gate: An evidence-linked instruction/feedback → decision → operation/state → token chain, with required work retained. Report the resolution actually supported: a B group is not proof that one particular sentence caused the effect. No renamed repetition of the already-weak inherited completion-cue screen.

tasks.question: Refresh × continuation joint check, C08 × C25.
tasks.scope: **Test the known refresh × continuation joint hypothesis (C08 × C25).** First qualify one connected historical author window where both mechanisms are exposed; if qualified and still needed, one joint-modified episode, with the full factor set declared.
tasks.completion_gate: A same-target joint contrast and observed refresh/continuation chain, or an evidence-based exclusion under the completion contract. Existing C08 and C25 means from different references cannot be added. Missing exposure or a broken seam leaves this test blocked, not negative.

tasks.question: Author policy × refresh × continuation joint check, A+B+C08+C25.
tasks.scope: **Test author policy × refresh × continuation jointly.** The declared set is A+B+C08+C25, not an unspecified mixture. Qualify the common reference and intervention boundary before one conditional shallow episode.
tasks.completion_gate: Observed activation and decision chains for the connected joint package, with a directly measured joint contrast. It is not the sum of P04 and P06. If the standalone host and WL continuation/refresh paths cannot be faithfully combined in the permitted machinery, record that exact blocker inside P07.

tasks.question: Remaining exercised whole-package interaction: custody/tools, information, review/repair, lifecycle, scheduling and auxiliary work.
tasks.scope: **Check the remaining whole-package interaction.** Conditional residual screen covering the other exercised differences in the P02 manifest: native tools/write custody; read/output/evidence representation; edit/check/review feedback; policy/context lifecycle; scheduling/stale-state/integration; auxiliary model work. Include their interaction with the already-tested package. Shared, absent and purely host-side paths require source-backed exclusions.
tasks.completion_gate: A qualified complete-package contrast plus an upstream trace for any new signal, or evidence that the verified package/residual already covers these differences. One bounded connected screen at most; existing failed host/parser experiments are not rerun under a new name. An unimplementable package or unresolved exercised difference remains a coverage blocker, not proof of zero.

tasks.question: One three-workflow confirmation batch of the strongest qualified reversal, with all required stages.
tasks.scope: **Confirm the strongest qualified causal reversal through complete workflows.** Select one named eligible arm from the above evidence; run exactly three modified full workflows concurrently, including normal reviews, fixes and integration, against the fixed saved reference.
tasks.completion_gate: A retained three-run result with mechanism activation, complete-stage outcomes and uncertainty. No fresh ordinary WL/Direct controls, all-on reproduction, automatic replacement or selection of only successful outcomes. No eligible signal means this task remains blocked, not a completed confirmation.

tasks.question: Source/input/activation and complete distinct-response accounting for every new observation.
tasks.scope: **Validate all new observations and usage.** Use the existing audit core once per closed observation: input/factor fidelity, source joins, distinct responses, resume/compaction ownership, failures, partials and missing tails.
tasks.completion_gate: One complete evidence roster and qualified accounting for every actual admission, including stopped observations. Failed qualification is attached to the affected contrast; it is not repaired by dropping that observation. No original-baseline native re-audit here.

tasks.question: Full author/review/repair/integration cost offsets.
tasks.scope: **Measure work shifted into later stages.** Compare authors, reviews, review repairs and integration for P09 and its saved reference, retaining genuine defects, retests and retries.
tasks.completion_gate: A stage and work-trigger table with whole-workflow net effect. A cheaper author that causes later costs is not credited with its gross saving. Unrun workflows mean this calculation stays unavailable and the task unfinished.

tasks.question: Combined same-target effect, interactions and context amplification without double counting.
tasks.scope: **Calculate the combined effect without double counting.** Separate directly changed input bytes, decision-driven extra work, recharged history/compaction, interactions and overhead using qualified same-target evidence.
tasks.completion_gate: A joint amount/bound and an explicit unallocated remainder. Avoided responses and the messages inside those responses are one cost, not multiple savings. Do not force unique additive factor percentages when the experiment identifies only a conditional or joint effect.

tasks.question: Historical six-vs-six transfer, explained amount/share and justified residual.
tasks.scope: **Connect that mechanism and amount to the original six-vs-six gap.** Match the actual historical exposed pathways/stages and justify transfer from the new contrasts; retain cohort/client/input differences and sampling limits.
tasks.completion_gate: Supported explained raw amount and share of the accepted 16.391M–18.645M gap per workflow, with an honestly bounded residual and coverage decision. The accepted historical interval is a measurement interval, not statistical confidence. Reproducing approximately 50% elsewhere does not complete this task.

tasks.question: Evidence-backed executable non-WL causal recipe; reuse existing real execution where it matches.
tasks.scope: **Provide and verify the non-WL causal recipe.** Specify the instructions, real commit/check feedback, permissions, validation and handoff rules that the evidence identifies, including failure/recovery behavior. Link executable entry points and exact source/input pins.
tasks.completion_gate: The recipe is evidenced by actual retained non-WL execution, and its causal reversal by qualified contrasts. Reuse the existing complete reproduction when it matches; do not spend another all-on workflow just to get a low total. A recipe/input mismatch remains a verification blocker.

tasks.question: Original-benchmark error/accounting/configuration check only after valid causal coverage fails to reconcile the gap.
tasks.scope: **Conditional original-benchmark error check, only after valid cause coverage.** If qualified completed causal work cannot reconcile the gap, inspect the original admitted roster, arithmetic, response/resume ownership, omitted charges, caps, configuration/population boundary and selection once.
tasks.completion_gate: Either a concrete demonstrated error and corrected result, or a documented no-error-found outcome with remaining limits. Harness failure or unrun science cannot trigger this branch. An inability to explain the gap is not itself an error. No new baseline generation or quality study; this branch needs explicit approval as part of the scope.

tasks.question: Final source/coverage acceptance of the requested causal answer or concrete corrected benchmark error.
tasks.scope: **Final evidence and coverage acceptance.** Check P01–P15, the 69-entry register and all included joint/residual boundaries against the requested answer.
tasks.completion_gate: Either verified upstream cause(s), quantified historical contribution/residual and non-WL reproduction, or a concrete original-benchmark error with its corrected result. If neither is established, keep this item blocked and report the exact missing evidence; do not manufacture scientific completion from closed attempts. User-directed closure without an answer must be explicit.
